doc: Versioned providers. Qualification is bound to an exact version and configuration and never floats. A tentative mapping stays tentative until an actual implementation schema and an observed trace bind it; a plugin name is not a capability definition.

impl.local_packaging.zipstore.v1.qualificationBasis: offline conformance plus a real observed local execution captured end to end

resourceProfile.note: a real local trace with no vendor usage supports time, replay and correctness claims, not a measured token reduction

impl.prior_context.checkpoint_store.v1.qualificationBasis: fresh-process resume test restores the required-fact inventory without conversation history

impl.reference.local_manifest.v1.qualificationBasis: resolves admitted source manifests to exact bytes with a retrieval receipt

impl.cityqa.runner.v1_0_0.qualificationBasis: preserved source package; its own 128 tests re-observed on this host under CPython 3.10.8

impl.cityqa.auditor.v1_0_0.qualificationBasis: preserved source package with its own recomputation boundary

impl.unreal.remote_control.v_unbound.qualificationBasis: no live probe is authorized under this development task; the collector is authored and offline-tested only

negativeQualification.subject: remote code execution endpoint
negativeQualification.boundTo: the exact configuration observed in the historical report
negativeQualification.note: Configuration-bound only. This does not authorize a re-probe or a settings change, and it does not generalize to another build or configuration.

impl.view.html_svg.v1.qualificationBasis: accessible static HTML and SVG generated from committed semantic inputs

impl.view.raster.cairosvg.qualificationBasis: optional raster backend; not importable in this environment
impl.view.raster.cairosvg.note: A missing renderer is an unavailable view, not a successful picture. SVG remains authoritative.

impl.provider.tentative_plugin_map.qualificationBasis: the five plugin-name mappings from the proposal are names only; no implementation schema or observed trace binds them yet
impl.provider.tentative_plugin_map.note: Kept explicitly TENTATIVE rather than promoted to a capability by naming.
